item.title: SecureBank: Building a Vulnerable Banking API to Learn AppSec Properly
item.description:
I wanted to actually learn AppSec by building something, not just reading about it — so I built SecureBank, a deliberately vulnerable Flask banking API. The twist: instead of just finding bugs in someone else’s intentionally-broken app, I built the whole thing myself — the app, the vulnerabilities, and a real CI/CD security pipeline to try and catch them.

Why a banking API Link to heading
